definitions.explanation: The current era or contemporary period.

examples.japanese: {現代|げんだい}{日本語|にほんご}
{現代|げんだい}{人|じん}の{生活|せいかつ}
{現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}では、テクノロジーが{生活|せいかつ}のあらゆる{場面|ばめん}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えている。
examples.english: In modern society, technology affects every aspect of life.

notes:
{現代|げんだい} means the current era or contemporary period. It can function as a noun or as a prefix modifying other nouns.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {現代|げんだい}{的|てき}: modern, contemporary (na-adjective)
- {現代|げんだい}{人|じん}: modern person
- {現代|げんだい}{社会|しゃかい}: modern society
- {現代|げんだい}{文学|ぶんがく}: contemporary literature
- {現代|げんだい}{語|ご}: modern language

JAPANESE HISTORICAL PERIODS:
- {古代|こだい}: ancient times (before ~1185)
- {中世|ちゅうせい}: medieval period (~1185-1603)
- {近世|きんせい}: early modern period (~1603-1868)
- {近代|きんだい}: modern era (~1868-1945)
- {現代|げんだい}: contemporary era (1945-present)

Note that both {近代|きんだい} and {現代|げんだい} translate as "modern" in English, but in Japanese historical usage they refer to different periods. {近代|きんだい} covers the Meiji through early Showa periods, while {現代|げんだい} refers to the postwar era onward.
